component.name: Hagency
component.summary: Projects, Matrix chat and locally managed AI Agents

description.p: Hagency is a native desktop application for Windows, macOS and Linux. It combines Project workspaces, Matrix chat and locally executed AI Agents. Sign in to a Hagency server through its Pasion browser authorization.

Create or connect Project Spaces and discussion Rooms, configure your own Agents and local model resources, and manage scoped execution and approvals. Account switching keeps each account's local data and runtime separate.
The Rust/Makepad interface is derived from Robrix and uses Project Robius platform libraries. Their copyright and license notices are retained.

Your server and configured model providers apply their own data policies. Human Matrix chat supports encryption; encrypted-Room Agent execution is currently deferred. Review the data and privacy documentation before use.

ul.li: Projects, Room membership and access controls
Agent identity, execution devices, model resources and usage limits
Matrix conversations, threads, reactions, files and encrypted human chat
Scoped mini apps, an article editor and saved-account switching

description.p: Hagency is free and open source. Contributions, bug reports, and feature requests are more than welcome.
